title: Salts - 123 school
heading: Salts
intro: You learn these terms and calculations by practising. Only use BINAS when the question names a BINAS table.

questions.question: What is a salt?

answers.a: A substance built up of atoms with shared electrons
answers.b: A substance that always tastes like table salt
answers.c: A substance built up of molecules
answers.d: A substance made up of positive and negative ions

questions.question: Which bond holds the ions together in a salt?

answers.a: The ionic bond (attraction between positive and negative ions)

questions.question: Why does solid table salt not conduct electricity?

answers.a: The ions are fixed in their places in the lattice

You mix solutions of silver nitrate and sodium chloride. Which substance precipitates? (use BINAS table 45A)
